scope: Exploratory sequence-separated supplementary study; not a fresh unseen-identity test or reproduction of supplied numbers
preprocessing: Official 96x96 eye-aligned grayscale crops decoded BGR; resize to 112x112 INTER_CUBIC before corruption; cubic down/up at medium 56x56 and severe 28x28; no detector or new alignment
degradation: mild Gaussian 3x3 sigma1 JPEG75; medium Gaussian 5x5 sigma2 cubic56 JPEG50; severe Gaussian7x7 sigma3.5 cubic28 independent Gaussian noise sigma15 then JPEG25; float noise added then rounded/clipped uint8
selection: First available numeric frame for one-photo gallery; earliest non-overlapping five-consecutive-frame tracks up to cap; no frontal-quality claim or outcome-based selection
calibration: Per-condition/method fixed and floored-AOSM thresholds selected only from calibration unknown maximum scores at <=1% observed FPIR; lowest admissible threshold; no evaluation-label selection
